notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Added a tutorial panel explaining the main points in the game. Sign "!" on the left side of the screen
Increased starting resources
Some changes in the economy:
[list]
[*] Reduced resource consumption by colonists
[*] Increased the amount of energy for the energy module and fuel cell
[*] Changed the time of extraction of some resources
[/list]
Some bugs fix
